big_case.notes: Paid FAA petition from the Third Circuit asking whether a court with jurisdiction over a pending 28 U.S.C. 1782 discovery application may entertain Section 3/4 motions to stay and compel arbitration. First-impression, no split, private cross-border litigation-funding dispute; the Court disposed of it by GVR in light of Jules v. Andre Balazs Properties rather than plenary review, so it sets no doctrine of its own. Modest significance for the arbitration/1782 bar only.
